title: Arenacraft forever
description: A smaller tournament to keep the pace going. Due to concurrent WoW Forever release we expect a smaller player count. A more chill tourney, we will experiment with MCH format here. The goal here is continue tech development for larger tourneys
format: SoloQ MCH, King of the Hill
